rows.name: analysis_task_intents
rows.sql:
CREATE TABLE analysis_task_intents (
    task_intent_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    book_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES books(book_id),
    kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('factual-recheck', 'learning-curation', 'baseline-manuscript-analysis', 'factual-review', 'evaluation', 'readers-report', 'evaluation-rewrite', 'writing') OR kind GLOB 'editorial-review/[a-z]*'
      OR kind GLOB 'custom-analysis/[a-z0-9-]*'),
    contract_version TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(contract_version IN ('ai7.factual-claim-verification/1', 'ai7.qualified-learning-curation/1', 'ai7.baseline-manuscript-analysis/1', 'ai7.factual-review/1', 'ai7.editorial-review/1', 'ai7.editorial-review/2', 'ai7.evaluation/1', 'ai7.readers-report/1', 'ai7.evaluation-rewrite/1',
      'ai7.writing/1') OR contract_version GLOB 'ai7.custom-analysis*/[0-9]*'),
    goal TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(goal) BETWEEN 1 AND 400),
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    canonical_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    sha256 TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(length(sha256) = 64),
    mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(mode IN ('factual-recheck', 'learning-curation', 'first-baseline', 'sync-current', 'reanalyze-range', 'reanalyze-book', 'whole-manuscript', 'range',
      'review-first', 'review-first-range', 'review-again', 'review-sync', 'review-range', 'evaluation-first', 'evaluation-again',
      'readers-report-first', 'readers-report-again', 'evaluation-rewrite-first', 'evaluation-rewrite-again', 'writing-first', 'writing-again')),
    predecessor_revision_id TEXT REFERENCES analysis_result_set_revisions(revision_id),
    selected_start_position INTEGER CHECK(selected_start_position IS NULL OR selected_start_position >= 1),
    selected_end_position INTEGER CHECK(selected_end_position IS NULL OR selected_end_position >= selected_start_position),
    CHECK((kind = 'factual-recheck' AND contract_version = 'ai7.factual-claim-verification/1' AND mode = 'factual-recheck') OR (kind = 'learning-curation' AND contract_version = 'ai7.qualified-learning-curation/1' AND mode = 'learning-curation') OR (kind = 'baseline-manuscript-analysis' AND contract_version = 'ai7.baseline-manuscript-analysis/1'
        AND mode IN ('first-baseline', 'sync-current', 'reanalyze-range', 'reanalyze-book'))
      OR (kind = 'factual-review' AND contract_version = 'ai7.factual-review/1'
        AND mode IN ('whole-manuscript', 'range', 'review-first-range', 'review-again', 'review-range'))
      OR (kind GLOB 'editorial-review/[a-z]*' AND contract_version IN ('ai7.editorial-review/1', 'ai7.editorial-review/2')
        AND mode IN ('review-first', 'review-first-range', 'review-again', 'review-sync', 'review-range'))
      OR (kind = 'evaluation' AND contract_version = 'ai7.evaluation/1'
        AND mode IN ('evaluation-first', 'evaluation-again'))
      OR (kind = 'readers-report' AND contract_version = 'ai7.readers-report/1'
        AND mode IN ('readers-report-first', 'readers-report-again'))
      OR (kind = 'evaluation-rewrite' AND contract_version = 'ai7.evaluation-rewrite/1'
        AND mode IN ('evaluation-rewrite-first', 'evaluation-rewrite-again'))
      OR (kind = 'writing' AND contract_version = 'ai7.writing/1'
        AND mode IN ('writing-first', 'writing-again'))
      OR (kind GLOB 'custom-analysis/[a-z0-9-]*' AND contract_version GLOB 'ai7.custom-analysis*/[0-9]*'
        AND mode IN ('first-baseline', 'sync-current', 'reanalyze-range', 'reanalyze-book'))),
    CHECK((mode IN ('factual-recheck', 'learning-curation', 'first-baseline', 'whole-manuscript', 'review-first', 'review-first-range', 'evaluation-first', 'readers-report-first',
      'evaluation-rewrite-first', 'writing-first')) = (predecessor_revision_id IS NULL)),
    CHECK((mode IN ('reanalyze-range', 'range', 'review-first-range', 'review-range')) = (selected_start_position IS NOT NULL)),
    CHECK((selected_start_position IS NULL) = (selected_end_position IS NULL))
  ) STRICT

      ('preserve-current-identity', 'create-new-identity', 'retire-current-identity')),
    current_kind TEXT CHECK(current_kind IS NULL OR current_kind IN ('title', 'heading', 'paragraph', 'note')),
    current_level INTEGER,

    lineage_level INTEGER,

    lineage_digest TEXT CHECK(lineage_digest IS NULL OR length(lineage_digest) = 64),
    staged_kind TEXT CHECK(staged_kind IS NULL OR staged_kind IN ('title', 'heading', 'paragraph', 'note')),
    staged_level INTEGER,
    staged_text TEXT,
    staged_digest TEXT CHECK(staged_digest IS NULL OR length(staged_digest) = 64),
    resolved_changed INTEGER CHECK(resolved_changed IS NULL OR resolved_changed IN (0, 1)),
    UNIQUE(comparison_id, position),
    CHECK(current_block_id IS NOT NULL OR staged_block_id IS NOT NULL),
    CHECK((current_block_id IS NULL) = (current_kind IS NULL)),
    CHECK((current_block_id IS NULL) = (current_text IS NULL)),
    CHECK((current_block_id IS NULL) = (current_digest IS NULL)),
    CHECK((lineage_block_id IS NULL) = (lineage_kind IS NULL)),
    CHECK((lineage_block_id IS NULL) = (lineage_text IS NULL)),
    CHECK((lineage_block_id IS NULL) = (lineage_digest IS NULL)),
    CHECK((staged_block_id IS NULL) = (staged_kind IS NULL)),
    CHECK((staged_block_id IS NULL) = (staged_text IS NULL)),
    CHECK((staged_block_id IS NULL) = (staged_digest IS NULL)),
    CHECK(
      (change_kind = 'unchanged' AND current_block_id IS NOT NULL AND staged_block_id IS NOT NULL
        AND current_position = staged_position AND identity_consequence = 'preserve-current-identity')
      OR (change_kind = 'move' AND current_block_id IS NOT NULL AND staged_block_id IS NOT NULL
        AND current_position != staged_position AND identity_consequence = 'preserve-current-identity')
      OR (change_kind = 'edit' AND current_block_id IS NOT NULL AND staged_block_id IS NOT NULL
        AND identity_consequence IS NULL)
      OR (change_kind = 'insert' AND current_block_id IS NULL AND staged_block_id IS NOT NULL
        AND identity_consequence IS NULL)

rows.name: abandonment_cleanup_validate_insert
rows.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER abandonment_cleanup_validate_insert
  BEFORE INSERT ON import_abandonment_cleanup_intents
  WHEN NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM import_drafts d
      JOIN content_objects co ON co.object_digest = d.object_digest
      WHERE d.draft_id = NEW.draft_id
        AND d.state IN ('staged', 'reviewed')
        AND d.draft_version = NEW.expected_draft_version
        AND d.object_digest = NEW.object_digest
        AND co.relative_key = NEW.relative_key
    )
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM source_versions sv WHERE sv.object_digest = NEW.object_digest)
    OR (SELECT count(*) FROM import_drafts d WHERE d.object_digest = NEW.object_digest) != 1
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM import_commits c WHERE c.draft_id = NEW.draft_id)
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM import_commit_attempts a
      WHERE a.draft_id = NEW.draft_id AND a.state != 'prepared'
    )
  BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'ABANDONMENT_CLEANUP_INVALID');
  END

rows.name: abandonment_cleanup_validate_intent_update_v5
rows.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER abandonment_cleanup_validate_intent_update_v5
  BEFORE UPDATE ON import_abandonment_cleanup_intents
  WHEN NEW.draft_id != OLD.draft_id
    OR NEW.object_digest != OLD.object_digest
    OR NEW.expected_draft_version != OLD.expected_draft_version
    OR NEW.relative_key != OLD.relative_key
    OR NEW.requested_at != OLD.requested_at
    OR NOT (
      (
        OLD.state = 'prepared' AND OLD.bytes_removed_at IS NULL
        AND NEW.state = 'bytes-removed' AND NEW.bytes_removed_at IS NOT NULL
      )
      OR (
        OLD.state = 'bytes-removed' AND NEW.state = 'bytes-removed'
        AND NEW.bytes_removed_at = OLD.bytes_removed_at
      )
    )
  BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'ABANDONMENT_CLEANUP_INTENT_IMMUTABLE');
  END

rows.name: imported_skill_update_candidates_transition
rows.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER imported_skill_update_candidates_transition BEFORE INSERT ON imported_skill_update_candidates
    WHEN NEW.sequence != (SELECT coalesce(max(sequence), 0) + 1 FROM imported_skill_update_candidates WHERE candidate_id = NEW.candidate_id)
      OR NEW.sequence > 2
      OR (NEW.sequence > 1 AND (SELECT skill_id FROM imported_skill_update_candidates WHERE candidate_id = NEW.candidate_id AND sequence = 1) IS NOT NEW.skill_id)
      OR (NEW.event = 'created' AND (
        (SELECT skill_id FROM imported_skill_snapshots WHERE snapshot_id = NEW.from_snapshot_id) IS NOT NEW.skill_id
        OR (SELECT skill_id FROM imported_skill_snapshots WHERE snapshot_id = NEW.to_snapshot_id) IS NOT NEW.skill_id
        OR (SELECT skill_id FROM imported_skill_revisions WHERE revision_id = NEW.base_revision_id) IS NOT NEW.skill_id
        OR (SELECT snapshot_id FROM imported_skill_revisions WHERE revision_id = NEW.base_revision_id) IS NOT NEW.from_snapshot_id
        OR NEW.from_snapshot_id = NEW.to_snapshot_id))
      OR (NEW.event = 'adopted' AND (
        (SELECT skill_id FROM imported_skill_revisions WHERE revision_id = NEW.adopted_revision_id) IS NOT NEW.skill_id
        OR (SELECT snapshot_id FROM imported_skill_revisions WHERE revision_id = NEW.adopted_revision_id)
          IS NOT (SELECT to_snapshot_id FROM imported_skill_update_candidates WHERE candidate_id = NEW.candidate_id AND sequence = 1)
        OR (NEW.adopted_by = 'rule' AND (
          (SELECT skill_id FROM imported_skill_update_rules WHERE rule_id = NEW.rule_id) IS NOT NEW.skill_id
          OR (SELECT action FROM imported_skill_update_rules WHERE skill_id = NEW.skill_id ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 1) IS NOT 'create'
          OR (SELECT disposition FROM imported_skill_update_candidates WHERE candidate_id = NEW.candidate_id AND sequence = 1) IS NOT 'clean'))))
    BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'IMPORTED_SKILL_UPDATE_CANDIDATE_INVALID'); END
